$comment: Benchmark model tiers. Models are never committed to Git and never redistributed by this project; they are pulled from their upstream source at benchmark time. Tiers exist so results are comparable within a tier. Every tier records its licence and where that licence was read, because a benchmark that tells you to download weights owes you the terms attached to them.

smoke.description: Tiny model for installation and functionality checks.

standard.description: Roughly 1B-4B quantized model; the default comparison tier.
standard.commercial_use: custom commercial licence; acceptance required before download, and additional restrictions apply. Read it before use.

performance.description: Roughly 7B-14B where hardware permits (>=12 GB VRAM recommended).

high-memory.description: Large models for workstations/high-memory platforms (>=24 GB VRAM or unified memory).

default_workload.prompt: Explain what a token is in large language models, in two sentences.

licensing_note: Licences are recorded as read from the upstream model card on the stated date, not interpreted. They can change; re-check before relying on one. This project distributes no weights.
